minutes.headline: Sewer Commission moved to issue the pump station RFP as written (version A), over a member's objection that legal's edits went undiscussed.
minutes.summary: The remote meeting centered on which version of the pump station operations and maintenance RFP to issue. The chair favored the version without counsel's late edits, and one member objected that the legal changes were not discussed. The commission also heard updates on irrigation meter policy, talks with Leominster on infiltration and inflow, the Bright Farms sewer payment, FY20 closeout, encumbrances, and a trial of sending agendas and approved minutes to other boards.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to issue version A of the pump station operations and maintenance RFP; a member objected that counsel's edits were not discussed.
A first motion to accept the RFP as written drew no second; the vote count on the later motion was not audible in the recording.
A payment from the Bright Farms allocation, due to Fitchburg, was not budgeted for FY21, so a special town meeting article may be needed.
The commission approved FY19 and FY20 encumbrances, and the business manager will ask Fitchburg whether the loan can be paid down without interest.
The commission set a trial of sending agendas and approved minutes to other town boards; the irrigation meter policy change was deferred.

why_it_matters: The pump station contract covers a core sewer service, and the choice of RFP text sets the terms bidders will price, which feeds into sewer rates.
An unbudgeted payment to Fitchburg could reach residents as a special town meeting article, a vote they may be asked to take.

The completed RFP and schedule the business manager is to send to the board, and any special town meeting article on the Fitchburg payment.
